title: Computer Vision Basics
overview: Explore how machines represent images as arrays and extract features for tasks like classification and detection.
objectives: Apply convolution filters such as edge detectors

method.title: Images as arrays
method.body: A grayscale image is a 2D grid of intensities; color images add a channel dimension.

method.title: Convolution
method.body: Sliding a small kernel across an image highlights local patterns such as edges.

method.title: Vision tasks
method.body: Classification labels a whole image, detection locates objects with boxes, and segmentation labels each pixel.

method.title: Learned features
method.body: Convolutional neural networks learn their filters from data instead of relying on hand-designed ones.

pseudocode:
for each position (i, j):
    patch = image[i:i+k, j:j+k]
    out[i, j] = sum(patch * kernel)
features = pool(relu(out))
